item: The slot arithmetic counts the crash-evidence change's 10,329 bytes and computes the crash-trace worst case from the export's own constants; thread_phases leaves no frame cycle
summary: OTHER_NEW_MEMBERS_BYTES 1,194,000 + 10,329 (oom_counters 2,145 + native libs 6,437 + can_answer 1,747) = 1,204,329, so a part keeps 1,502,415 bytes free (2,415 over the 1,500,000 floor). The crash-trace figure is computed from exit_evidence's constants and bounded at 400,000 (a mutation to 4000 lines fails it; with the crash-evidence change it is 397,280). sys._current_frames() holds the asking thread's frame and that frame held the snapshot, a cycle that kept every local up the stack alive until the next collection: both names are dropped in a finally, with two tests that run the collector off and watch a local by weak reference. The docstring no longer says a client reads X-OO-Paused.
